question: In a village of 1000 inhabitants, there are three newspapers $P$, $Q$ and $R$ in circulation. Each of these papers is read by 500 persons. Papers $P$ and $Q$ are read by 250 persons, papers $Q$ and $R$ are read by 250 persons, papers $R$ and $P$ are read by 250 persons. All the three papers are read by 250 persons. Then the number of persons who read no newspaper at all

options.D: cannot be determined from the given information
